activities.name: Vehicle inspection
activities.interaction: Inspect tires, fluid levels, lights and dashboard alerts; record findings
activities.assessment: Identify faults and justify safe next steps

activities.name: Diagnostic reasoning
activities.interaction: Select test points and interpret simulated diagnostic signals
activities.assessment: Match symptoms to evidence without guessing

worlds.name: Clinical Skills University
worlds.environment: Virtual hospital with anatomy and simulation labs

activities.name: 3D heart anatomy
activities.interaction: Rotate and label heart chambers, valves and major vessels; explore circulation

activities.name: 3D brain anatomy
activities.interaction: Explore brain regions and their basic functions on an anatomical model
activities.assessment: Identify key regions and their functions

activities.name: Operating room simulation
activities.interaction: Practice team roles, sterile-field awareness, patient safety checks and observe conceptual cardiac and neurosurgical simulations
activities.assessment: Recognize safety checkpoints; no unsupervised surgical procedure instructions

worlds.clinicalNotice: Simulation for education only; not a substitute for accredited medical education, clinical supervision or surgical credentialing.

worlds.name: Construction Equipment Training Yard
worlds.environment: Virtual construction site with excavator, loader and crane models

activities.name: Worksite safety inspection
activities.interaction: Walk the site, flag hazards, check exclusion zones and identify spotter signals
activities.assessment: Detect all critical hazards before simulated startup

activities.name: Equipment controls familiarization
activities.interaction: Identify virtual cab controls, read warning indicators and rehearse shutdown in a risk-free simulation
activities.assessment: Choose safe responses to fault scenarios

worlds.safetyNotice: No authorization to operate physical equipment; follow applicable employer and regulatory training requirements.

activities.name: Circuit diagnosis
activities.interaction: Build low-voltage simulated circuits and use a virtual meter
activities.assessment: Explain open and closed circuits and fault isolation

activities.name: Aircraft inspection principles
activities.interaction: Inspect a training aircraft model and document simulated discrepancies

activities.name: Food safety and kitchen workflow
activities.interaction: Spot cross-contamination hazards and organize safe workstation flow
activities.assessment: Identify correct hygiene and storage decisions
